mapper.select: SELECT i.investigation_id, i.incident_id, i.status, i.aggregate_version, i.authority_service, i.authority_epoch, i.authority_active_from, i.active_run_id, i.updated_at, b.max_steps, b.max_tool_calls, b.max_tokens, b.max_duration_seconds, b.used_steps, b.used_tool_calls, b.used_tokens, b.used_duration_seconds FROM investigation i JOIN investigation_budget b ON b.investigation_id = i.investigation_id WHERE i.investigation_id = #{investigationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE investigation_budget SET max_steps = #{budget.maxSteps}, max_tool_calls = #{budget.maxToolCalls}, max_tokens = #{budget.maxTokens}, max_duration_seconds = #{budget.maxDurationSeconds}, used_steps = #{budget.usedSteps}, used_tool_calls = #{budget.usedToolCalls}, used_tokens = #{budget.usedTokens}, used_duration_seconds = #{budget.usedDurationSeconds}, aggregate_version = #{version} WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_publication_intent ( intent_id, event_id, investigation_id, run_id, aggregate_version, aggregate_sequence, authority_service, authority_epoch, created_at, publication_state ) VALUES ( #{intentId}, #{eventId}, #{investigationId}, #{runId}, #{aggregateVersion}, #{aggregateSequence}, #{authorityEpoch.service}, #{authorityEpoch.epoch}, #{createdAt}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(progress_sequence) FROM investigation_progress WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId}
SELECT MAX(progress_sequence) FROM investigation_progress WHERE investigation_id = #{investigationId}

SELECT intent_id, event_id, investigation_id, topic_name, aggregate_sequence, aggregate_version, authority_epoch, canonical_content, canonical_sha256, created_at, attempt_count FROM diagnosis_publication_intent WHERE canonical_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND created_at >= #{oldest} AND ((publication_state = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (publication_state = 'LEASED' AND lease_expires_at <= #{now})) ORDER BY created_at, intent_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE diagnosis_publication_intent SET publication_state = 'LEASED', lease_owner = #{owner}, fencing_token = #{token}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE intent_id = #{intentId} AND ((publication_state = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (publication_state = 'LEASED' AND lease_expires_at <= #{now}))

UPDATE diagnosis_publication_intent SET publication_state = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_at = #{acknowledgedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, fencing_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE intent_id = #{intentId} AND publication_state = 'LEASED' AND fencing_token = #{token}

UPDATE diagnosis_publication_intent SET publication_state = #{state}, next_attempt_at = #{retryAt}, last_failure_code = #{reasonCode}, lease_owner = NULL, fencing_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE intent_id = #{intentId} AND publication_state = 'LEASED' AND fencing_token = #{token}

UPDATE diagnosis_publication_intent SET publication_state = 'PENDING', next_attempt_at = #{requestedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, fencing_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, last_failure_code = NULL WHERE intent_id = #{intentId} AND canonical_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND publication_state IN ('ACKNOWLEDGED', 'TERMINAL_FAILURE')
mapper.select: SELECT intent_id, event_id, investigation_id, topic_name, aggregate_sequence, aggregate_version, authority_epoch, canonical_content, canonical_sha256, created_at, attempt_count FROM diagnosis_publication_intent WHERE intent_id = #{intentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diagnosis_publication_intent WHERE publication_state IN ('PENDING', 'LEASED')
